subject: GPU deployment readiness & activation gate — Cobalt Systems
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Nov 2028 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: quick check — Cobalt late-stage GPU needs

Team,

Cobalt Systems is moving to final contract this week (deal COB-2028-1178). They expect to run a short internal POC followed by a production pilot that will need a sustained 80 TFLOPS-equivalent capacity (roughly 18 A100-class GPUs) during peak hours, and an average burst profile around 28 GPUs for the first month. They want an activation window starting 2028-12-04 if we can commit.

Can infra confirm:
- Available dedicated pool for 12/04–12/18 that can support 18 sustained GPUs with burst to 28
- Any conflicts with reservations already allocated for that window
- Rough estimate of cost to hold a soft allocation for two weeks (we may pass this as a short-term reservation fee)

I attached an initial capacity_runbook_v1.pdf that has the workload profile they shared. This is time-sensitive — marketing/sales are pressing for a line item in the SOW.

Ben
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@cobaltsys.com>
Cc: Cobalt Systems Procurement <procurement@cobaltsys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: staging window & activation gate for pilot (dates & pre-reqs)

Ethan —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. To keep the timeline tight and avoid surprises, we recommend a short staging window (2 weeks) followed by an activation gate before the pilot goes live. High level:

- Proposed staging window: 2028-12-04 to 2028-12-18
- Expected steady-state during staging: ~18 GPUs (A100-equivalent), with bursts up to 28 for retraining jobs
- Activation gate checklist: SOW signed, network peering validated, keys in KMS, and agreed metrics for latency/throughput

Can you confirm whether procurement can sign the SOW by 2028-11-30 and whether your infra team can commit to a hardened test on 12/06? We can place a soft allocation hold once infra confirms availability — if needed we’ll invoice a short-term reservation fee to keep the pool for you.

Attaching the draft SOW for review (Cobalt_Systems_SOW_draft.docx).

Best,
Ben
From: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@cobaltsys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cobalt Systems Procurement <procurement@cobaltsys.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 10:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: staging window & activation gate for pilot (dates & pre-reqs)

Ben —

Thanks. Procurement is aligned to target 11/30 for SOW signature. Our infra lead can do the hardened test on 12/06 but we need confirmation from your side about the soft-hold terms and any upfront fee. Also please confirm what failure/fallback policy you suggest if we see GPU contention during the staging window.

Ethan
Director, AI Platforms — Cobalt Systems

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 07:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: quick check — Cobalt late-stage GPU needs

Ben / team,

We ran the reservation checks against the Dec 04–18 runway. Short summary:
- We have an uncommitted pool that can cover the 18 sustained GPUs; burst to 28 is feasible if we throttle non-critical background jobs and shift a small set of scheduled trainings.
- Conflict: There's a partial reservation (internal POC) for 2028-12-10 to 12-12 that can be flexed to later in the week if we get Cobalt to take a soft hold by 11/22.
- Cost to hold (soft allocation, refundable) for two weeks: estimated $18,500 (covers reserve capacity & ops buffer).

Operational notes / recommended allocation approach:
1) Place a two-week soft hold tied to deal COB-2028-1178; include a modest refundable hold fee to disincentivize last-minute cancellations.
2) If signed SOW not received by 11/30, we release the hold on 12/01 with 48hr notice.
3) Prepare an alternate pool mapping (zone B -> zone C) to reduce impact to other reservations; we will need two admins to authorize the mapping during activation.

I attached activation_checklist.xlsx with the authorization steps and the minimal runbook. If you want, I can put the soft hold in the scheduler this afternoon (11/21) contingent on Ben getting procurement confirmation.

Monica
Senior Infra Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Internal: quick check — Cobalt late-stage GPU needs (pricing & hold fee)

Marissa / Rishi —

Per Monica below, we can place the soft hold for two weeks. Marissa, can finance add the refundable hold fee line to the SOW and confirm invoicing terms? Rishi, can you confirm whether the hold fee should be under the deal as a one-time prepayment or as a credit against the first invoice?

Suggested language for SOW amendment: "A refundable short-term reservation fee of $18,500 will be invoiced upon placement of a soft allocation hold; the fee will be credited against the first month of usage upon activation. If SOW is not executed by 2028-11-30, Redwood reserves the right to release the hold with 48 hours' notice and refund the hold fee minus a $1,000 operational processing charge."

I will wait for your confirmation; procurement has asked us to finalize terms today so they can route for signature.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@cobaltsys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Cobalt Systems Procurement <procurement@cobaltsys.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmation: soft hold placed (pending SOW signature)

Ethan / team —

Quick update: Infra confirmed we can place a two-week soft allocation hold for your staging window (2028-12-04 to 2028-12-18). We placed the hold this morning tied to deal COB-2028-1178 and created an authorization mapping (zone B -> zone C) that we will use during activation.

Terms: refundable short-term reservation fee $18,500 (credited against first month on activation). If we do not have a signed SOW by 2028-11-30 we will release the hold on 2028-12-01 with 48 hours' notice.

Next steps:
- Procurement: sign SOW by 11/30 (I attached the draft again).
- Infra (Monica): prep two admins for the zone mapping and run the hardened test on 12/06.
- Ops (Rishi / Priyom): validate fallback policy (downgrade to 14 GPUs sustained with fast KV-cache prioritization) in case of cross-reservation contention.

If that all sounds good, we'll move forward and schedule the activation rehearsal the week before the window.

Best,
Ben
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
Attachment: Cobalt_Systems_SOW_draft.docx
